---
title: '20260427'
version: 0.47.1
date: 2026-04-27
description: Added GPT-5.5 support, redesigned Agent settings, introduced a DeepSeek preset, and improved the sidebar, automatic file refresh, and overall stability.
---
### Agent Experience

- Added support for GPT-5.5
- Redesigned the Agent settings page with a new category sidebar and capability refresh flow
- Added a DeepSeek preset so you can paste a token and finish setup quickly
- Improved connection stability and capability detection for Agents such as Claude Code and Codex
- Fixed a macOS issue where using Codex could trigger a `ComputerUse` error popup

### Desktop Experience

- The left sidebar can now be collapsed, resized by dragging, and toggled with keyboard shortcuts
- Local projects, GitHub Worktrees, and Chat sections are clearer, with more consistent sidebar interactions
- Local file lists in sessions now refresh automatically, making changes easier to review as they happen

### Conversation Experience

- Streaming code blocks no longer flicker between highlighted and plain-text rendering
- Session initialization and switching are more stable, reducing occasional loading mix-ups

### Other Fixes

- Remote projects no longer incorrectly trigger local detection
- Machine online status and realtime sync are now more accurate
- Fixed bottom spacing in the CLI output area inside Electron
